subject: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: people-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching

Team —

Quick note to align on an accelerated onboarding plan for two incoming managers joining next week (starts 11/16). The goals are narrow: get them confident on our performance management process, policy boundaries for escalations, and run a hands-on difficult-conversations workshop so they can practice right away.

Proposed 2-week sprint (high level):
- Week 1: policy refresh + shadowing (PM process, probation timelines, documentation expectations)
- Week 1 mid: 2-hour role-play workshop (difficult conversations) run by an external facilitator
- Week 2: 1:1 mentoring pairs + calibration readout with EMs

I attached the latest manager playbook and a short agenda for the workshop. Asks:
- Marissa: can you own the mentorship pairings and distribution of the playbook?
- Laura: can you confirm CS/IC coverage so managers can shadow live on 11/17/11/18?
- Karthik: we need a short calibration slot during week 2 — preferred day/time?
- People Ops: confirm facilitator availability (I’ve cc'd them) and any compliance items to flag.

We should keep this lightweight but structured — the two hires will be high-impact and need practical practice on one-on-one performance conversations (not just slides).

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, People & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: people-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching

Vivek — happy to own mentorship pairings. I’ll draft a short intake form for EMs (skills gaps, areas to practice, availability). I can also append the current mentorship roster (attached).

Quick note on timing: if the workshop is during Week 1 mid, I recommend scheduling it on 11/18 afternoon so there’s time for shadowing earlier in the week. That avoids folks being pulled from critical demos on 11/17.

I’ll circulate pairings by EOD Thursday (11/12).

-Marissa

Subject: Re: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching

Vivek —

We can cover shadowing on 11/17 (AM) and 11/18 (AM). I’ll coordinate with the IC leads and ask them to reserve 60–90 minutes slots for the new managers. We have two product demos on 11/17 PM so Marissa’s suggestion to run the workshop on 11/18 PM is smart.

Also: two small policy flags for People Ops to confirm —
1) probation extension: what approvals do new managers have to request for a 30-day probation extension?
2) documentation retention: are there any differences in storing one-on-one notes if HR requests them for a future case?

Happy to take the calibration readout. Thu 11/26 is out (holiday in some regions); my preference is Tue 11/23 10:00–10:45 PT. Karthik — is that workable?

Laura

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching

Tue 11/23 10:00 PT works for me for the calibration readout. I’ll block 30–45 minutes and prepare a 5–7 minute data snapshot (OKRs impacted, recent ratings distribution, open performance plans) to keep it tight.

Couple of pragmatic asks:
- Can People Ops confirm whether the new managers should have view-only access to performance plans in BambooHR during their first 30 days? Makes coaching live reviews easier.
- For role-play scenarios, can we prioritize: (1) feedback on underperformance where role expectations weren't met, (2) a manager handling a request for a probation extension, (3) early coaching conversation for a high-potential IC showing counterproductive behavior.

I’ll sync with Marissa on pairings when you share the intake.

Karthik

Forwarding draft plan to Ellipsis to confirm facilitator availability and final agenda. Ellipsis — can you run the 2-hour role-play on 11/18 1:30–3:30 PT and provide two facilitators? Also, we want a short pre-work packet and a follow-up scorecard we can use in the calibration. Attached is our playbook and a suggested agenda. Please confirm cost and whether you can tailor one scenario to our probation-extension process.

Thanks,
Vivek

Subject: Re: Fwd: Manager transition & 2-week onboarding sprint: mentorship, policy & coaching

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. We can facilitate 11/18 13:30–15:30 PT with two trainers (Anu Patel and Marco Ruiz). We’ll provide a 20-minute pre-work packet and a one-page scorecard for calibration. Tailoring for a probation-extension scenario is fine — please send any relevant policy excerpts and we’ll bake that into a role-play.

Estimated cost: $2,800 for the session + customization (one round of revisions). We can issue an invoice to People Ops or add to your existing PO.

Confirmed deliverables:
- 20-min pre-work for participants
- 2-hour live role-play with two facilitators
- One-page calibration scorecard
- Optional 30-min follow-up coaching drop-in (add-on)

Will await the policy text for the probation scenario and the final participant list.

Best,
Maya 
Ellipsis Learning
trainings@ellipsislearning.com
